purpose: Compare the frozen successful temporal Weightsmith construction with matched-data teacher-action LoRA and unchanged-policy controls
original_prompt: Put the cube then the banana in the bowl
clarified_prompt: Put the cube in the bowl then put the banana in the bowl

lora.selection: Maximum strict original-request development successes; ties choose lower learning rate

primary_estimand: Weightsmith minus matched-source teacher-action LoRA success, paired by layout and noise slot
secondary_contrasts: Weightsmith versus base, matched random directions, and clarified input; report every arm and contrast regardless of result
secondary: Unchanged stock_final and stock_ever on the same strict-runtime trajectories
reset_gate: Existing runtime validates written/settled poses, velocities, orientation, and initially false goals at every reset before policy execution; failed reset stops the batch
statistics: Paired differences and 95% layout-cluster percentile intervals with 20000 shared resamples; 16 heldout layouts with four noise replicates each. No goal-population generalization or equivalence claim.
limitations: One previously studied repair goal; source decisions and Weightsmith weights are reused, not independently rediscovered
Same scene with small pose perturbations, not a new scene or robot
Same six construction observations and clarification, but activation regression and action-target LoRA have different objectives; historical construction search cost is not zero or fully matched
LoRA learning-rate selection uses up to 48 additional development episodes and is reported separately
Archived clarification actions and capture replay drift must be disclosed; no fabricated modern live-replay certificate
One realized matched-rank/spectrum random control before storage rounding
Matched nominal states and policy seeds do not imply identical rendered observations
The completed 96-episode artifact-recovery diagnostic is development evidence and is not pooled with this heldout cohort
